# NewDermaMed

> Medical aesthetics and laser clinic in Toronto, Canada, with two locations: Uptown (4763 Yonge Street, North York, M2N 5M5, 416-224-8800, Monday to Friday 9am to 7pm) and Downtown (790 Bay Street, Suite 900, Toronto, M5G 1N8, 416-671-9766, Monday to Friday 9am to 7pm, Saturday 10am to 5pm). Email info@newdermamed.com. Every treatment plan starts with a free consultation and a VISIA® skin analysis with the licensed medical team. Results vary from person to person.

Treatments: injectables (Botox®, Juvéderm®, dermal fillers, lip augmentation, tear trough correction, Belkyra®, Soft Lift™, mesotherapy and skin boosters), bio-stimulators (Aptos Thread Lift, Sculptra®, Radiesse®), skin treatments (microneedling, chemical peels, Dermamelan®, Acnelan®, exosome therapy, photo-rejuvenation, VISIA® skin analysis), laser (hair removal, skin resurfacing, micro laser peel, skin tightening, vein removal), body (CoolSculpting®, TightSculpting®, cellulite, stretch marks, hyperhidrosis), veins (sclerotherapy, EVLT, RFA, VenaSeal™) and hair (PRP, exosomes, laser hair rejuvenation). Medical-grade skincare from the clinic shop.

## Concerns

- [Acne & Breakouts: treatments in Toronto, NewDermaMed](https://newdermamedlaserclinic.com/concern-acne-breakouts.html): Breakouts can be calmed with the right combination of clinic treatments and skincare, at any age.
- [Acne Scars: treatments in Toronto, NewDermaMed](https://newdermamedlaserclinic.com/concern-acne-scars.html): Not every scar responds to the same treatment. Matching your scar type to the right option is what makes the difference.
- [Cellulite: treatments in Toronto, NewDermaMed](https://newdermamedlaserclinic.com/concern-cellulite.html): Dimpled, uneven skin on the thighs, buttocks, hips and abdomen can be smoothed with treatments that work beneath the surface.
- [Double Chin: treatments in Toronto, NewDermaMed](https://newdermamedlaserclinic.com/concern-double-chin.html): Fullness under the chin can hide a defined jawline even at a healthy weight. Non-surgical options can help define it.
- [Excessive Sweating: treatments in Toronto, NewDermaMed](https://newdermamedlaserclinic.com/concern-excessive-sweating.html): Sweating that soaks through clothes or makes you avoid handshakes can be treated, after an in-person medical assessment.
- [Hair Loss: treatments in Toronto, NewDermaMed](https://newdermamedlaserclinic.com/concern-hair-loss.html): A receding hairline, a thinning crown or patches of loss, assessed properly and treated without surgery.
- [Hyperpigmentation & Sun Spots: treatments in Toronto, NewDermaMed](https://newdermamedlaserclinic.com/concern-hyperpigmentation-sun-spots.html): Sun spots, uneven tone and marks after breakouts can be brightened once we know what is causing them.
- [Loose Skin: treatments in Toronto, NewDermaMed](https://newdermamedlaserclinic.com/concern-loose-skin.html): Firmness can be restored to the neck, arms, abdomen, knees and thighs without surgery, for mild to moderate laxity.
- [Melasma: treatments in Toronto, NewDermaMed](https://newdermamedlaserclinic.com/concern-melasma.html): Melasma needs a careful plan. The right protocol can lighten it while avoiding treatments that make it worse.
- [Moles & Skin Lesions: treatments in Toronto, NewDermaMed](https://newdermamedlaserclinic.com/concern-moles-skin-lesions.html): Safe mole removal after a medical evaluation, for cosmetic reasons or because a mole has changed.
- [Rosacea & Redness: treatments in Toronto, NewDermaMed](https://newdermamedlaserclinic.com/concern-rosacea-redness.html): Flushing and visible vessels can often be calmed with light-based treatments and a skin plan built around your triggers.
- [Sagging Skin & Jowls: treatments in Toronto, NewDermaMed](https://newdermamedlaserclinic.com/concern-sagging-skin-jowls.html): When the jawline softens or the cheeks start to drop, lift and support can be restored without surgery for many people.
- [Spider & Varicose Veins: treatments in Toronto, NewDermaMed](https://newdermamedlaserclinic.com/concern-spider-varicose-veins.html): From fine red veins to bulging, aching legs: assessed by our vascular team, with laser, injections and minimally invasive closure where needed.
- [Stretch Marks: treatments in Toronto, NewDermaMed](https://newdermamedlaserclinic.com/concern-stretch-marks.html): Red, purple or white marks after pregnancy, growth or weight change can be softened with treatments that rebuild collagen.
- [Stubborn Fat: treatments in Toronto, NewDermaMed](https://newdermamedlaserclinic.com/concern-stubborn-fat.html): Areas that do not change with diet and exercise can be contoured without surgery or downtime.
- [Thin Lips: treatments in Toronto, NewDermaMed](https://newdermamedlaserclinic.com/concern-thin-lips.html): Hyaluronic acid lip enhancement for definition, balance and hydration, planned to suit your face.
- [Thinning Hair: treatments in Toronto, NewDermaMed](https://newdermamedlaserclinic.com/concern-thinning-hair.html): Thinning hair is common in men and women, and earlier treatment usually gives better options.
- [Under-Eye Hollows & Dark Circles: treatments in Toronto, NewDermaMed](https://newdermamedlaserclinic.com/concern-under-eye-hollows-dark-circles.html): Shadows under the eyes have different causes, and the right treatment depends on which one you have.
